build_email_KEY_CREATED: build an email notification using KEY_CREATED_EMAIL_TEMPLATE to inform users of their new API key
build_email_USER_INVITED: build an invitation email using USER_INVITED_EMAIL_TEMPLATE for team onboarding
build_email_SOFT_BUDGET_ALERT: build a soft budget alert email using SOFT_BUDGET_ALERT_EMAIL_TEMPLATE when spend exceeds the soft limit
build_email_TEAM_SOFT_BUDGET_ALERT: build a team soft budget alert email using TEAM_SOFT_BUDGET_ALERT_EMAIL_TEMPLATE for team members
build_email_MAX_BUDGET_ALERT: build a maximum budget alert email using MAX_BUDGET_ALERT_EMAIL_TEMPLATE when approaching the budget cap
